uṭṭhahanta: [U+ṭhā+a+anta] (ti) CL=7 (A) getting up (getting up from bed, etc.) (B) Doing actively. Making an effort. (C) Appear. Emerge.
uṭṭhahati: [U+ṭhā+a+ti,haakkharālā] (kri) CL=7 (A) He gets up. (gets up from the bed or from sitting). (B) He climbs or arises. He climbs up. (C) He appears. (D) He emerges. (F) He appears. uṭṭhahitvā: [U+ṭhā+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 (A) Having got up (gets up from bed, sitting, etc.). (B) Having risen up. (C) Having appeared. (D) Having jumped out. (E) Having arisen.

uṭṭhitapāsāṇa: [Uṭṭhita+pāsāṇa] (pu) CL=7 The stone mat that appeared.
uṭṭhitaraja: [Uṭṭhita+raja]  CL=9 The dust that rises up.

uṭṭhāhaka: [U+ṭhā+ṇvu] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī uṭṭhāhikā] Doing something actively. Making an effort.
uṭṭhāna: [U+ṭhā+yu] (na) CL=7 (1) (A) Gets up (from the bed, the sitting position, etc.,). (B) Arises up or ascends. (C) Floating on the water. (D) Comes up or arises. (E) Having lost bowels due to suffering from flatulence. (2) Diligence. The dhamma that is a cause of practice actively. See - Uṭṭhānavīriyādhigata. (3) (A) Crops. The revenue of the country.
uṭṭhānaka: [Uṭṭhāna+ka] (ti) CL=7 (1) The goods that come from (the field) (which is paddy, etc.,) (2) One who is doing or practicing actively.
uṭṭhānakadāya: [Uṭṭhānaka+dāya] (pu,na) CL=7 The goods that come from (the field) (which is paddy, etc.,)
uṭṭhānakaloṇādimala: [Uṭṭhānaka+loṇādimala] (na) CL=7 The dirt that is arisen salt, etc.,

uṭṭhānakāla: [Uṭṭhāna+kāla] (pu) CL=7 (A) A period of making an effort. A period of doing actively.

uṭṭhānapādacariyā: [Uṭṭhāna+pādacariyā]  CL=9 Serving diligently on one"s feet.
uṭṭhānasamattha: [Uṭṭhāna+samattha] (ti) CL=7 One who is able to make an effort.
uṭṭhānasampadā: [Uṭṭhāna+sampadā] (thī) CL=7 Fulfilled with effort and exertion or successful initiative or accomplishment in undertakings.
uṭṭhānasampanna: [Uṭṭhāna+sampanna] (ti) CL=7 One who is fulfilled with effort and exertion or successful initiative.

uṭṭhānasīla: [Uṭṭhāna+sīla] (ti) CL=7 One who has a habit of waking up (from the bed).
uṭṭhānavantu: [Uṭṭhāna+vantu] (ti) CL=7 One who is actively doing something.

(B) Kāyikavīriya (diligence of the body) and Cetasikavīriya (diligence of the mind) which is a cause of doing actively. (C) Making an effort for benefit. The diligence that is suitable for that effort. See also - Uṭṭhānavīriyādhigata.
uṭṭhānavīriyasampadā: [Uṭṭhānavīriya+sampadā] (thī) CL=7 Fulfilled with effort and exertion.
uṭṭhānavīriyasampanna: [Uṭṭhānavīriya+sampanna] (ti) CL=7 Fulfilled with effort and exertion.
uṭṭhānavīriyasampatti: [Uṭṭhānavīriya+sampatti] (thī) CL=7 The fulfillment of diligence or effort and exertion.
uṭṭhānavīriyavantu: [Uṭṭhānavīriya+vantu] (ti) CL=7 One who is making active or making an effort. See also - Uṭṭhānavantu.
uṭṭhānavīriyābhinibbatta: [Uṭṭhānavīriya+abhinibbatta] (ti) CL=7 Generated by effort and exertion.
uṭṭhānavīriyābhāva: [Uṭṭhānavīriya+abhāva] (pu) CL=7 Lack of effort and exertion.
uṭṭhānavīriyādhigata: [Uṭṭhānavīriya+adhigata] (ti) CL=7 (A) Attained by diligence. (B) Attained by diligent physical activity and diligent mental activity. (C) Obtained the benefit by effort and exertion.
uṭṭhānaṭṭhāna: [Uṭṭhāna+ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 (A) Place of arising. (B) Place of occurrence. (C) Place of coming up. (D) Place of ascending.
uṭṭhānādhigata: [Uṭṭhāna+adhigata] (ti) CL=7 Achieved by effort and exertion.

uṭṭhāpanīya: [U+ṭhā+ṇāpe+anīya] (ti) CL=7 One who makes him get up (from the bed).
uṭṭhāpayamāna: [U+ṭhā+ṇāpaya+māna] (ti) CL=7 One who makes rises up.
uṭṭhāpayanta: [U+ṭhā+ṇāpaya+anta] (ti) CL=7 One who makes him get up.
uṭṭhāpayati: [U+ṭhā+ṇāpaya+ti] (kā,kri) CL=7 He makes someone get up.
uṭṭhāpenta: [U+ṭhā+ṇāpe+anta] (ti) CL=7 (A) Forcing to raise. (B) Making stand up.
uṭṭhāpeti: [U+ṭhā+ṇāpe+ti] (kā,kri) CL=7 (A) He makes rise. (B) He makes raise. (C) He makes someone get up. (D) He makes appear. (E) He makes come out.
uṭṭhāpetuṃ: [U+ṭhā+ṇāpe+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 (A) To make arise. (B) To make get up.
uṭṭhāpetvā: [U+ṭhā+ṇāpe+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 (A) Having made arisen. (B) Having made appear. (C) Having made get up. (D) Having made a turn to the top. (E) Having made pull-out. Having made save.
uṭṭhāpita: [U+ṭhā+ṇāpe+ta] (ti) CL=7 (A) That made someone get up. (B) That made arise. (C) That made appear.
uṭṭhātabbaṭṭhāna: [Uṭṭhātabba+ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 The place where should be got up.

uṭṭhātukāma: [Uṭṭhātuṃ+kāma] (ti) CL=7 One who is wanting to get up.
uṭṭhāya: [U+ṭhā+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 (A) Getting up. (B) Doing actively. Making effort and exertion. (C) Ascending.
uṭṭhāyaka: [U+ṭhā+ṇvu] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī uṭṭhāyikā] One who is doing actively or one who is making an effort and exertion.
